videoTitle: VS02 PRO Top-Mounted Parking AC Installation Guide
geometryPolicy: Use converted VS02 PRO STP/CAD mesh for final product geometry. Procedural geometry is allowed only for animatic previews.

sourceCad.status: STP files are identical; converted OBJ files are available in the external素材 directory. Use the lite OBJ for animation previews and the hero OBJ for higher-detail stills.

truckScene.description: Volvo FH 16 truck cab model found on the Desktop.

installPoint.note: Approximate centered roof position from the truck model bounds. Fine-tune after visual review.

exteriorDimensions.orientation: The 980 mm dimension is treated as front-to-back on the vehicle roof. The 680 mm dimension is treated as left-to-right. The 190 mm dimension is product height above roof.
exteriorDimensions.topDetail: Dual condenser fan area on the upper shell; cable connection is shown toward the rear.

roofOpening.message: Use the standard 14 in / 356 mm square roof opening and verify the roof area is structurally clear before cutting.

installationSteps: Show final installed interior air outlet first
Show VS02 PRO on the roof with the front-to-back orientation
Measure and confirm the 14 x 14 in / 356 mm roof opening
Clean roof surface and avoid reinforcement beams
Apply foam gasket or butyl seal around the opening
Lower the exterior unit straight down and centered
Install interior mounting frame and tighten four bolts in a cross pattern
Connect 12V/24V DC power with fuse protection near the battery
Power on and confirm cool airflow

electrical.productPageFuse: 30A inline fuse within 18 in of the battery
electrical.onscreenRule: Place fuse protection near the battery before testing.

safetyLabels: Keep gasket surface clean and dry
Tighten bolts evenly in a cross pattern
Place fuse protection near the battery

shotStyle.opening: Start with the finished installed look, then explain the work.
shotStyle.pace: Clean, practical, product-forward, readable at mobile size.
shotStyle.differentiator: Make the 14 x 14 in roof opening, four-bolt mounting, and fused DC power path unmistakable.
